decisions.reason: As a large German maritime-support firm, we would likely keep this adjacent offshore-management unit because it fits core capabilities and available slack makes us tolerate uncertain early results rather than exit quickly.
We would keep this service because it is closely tied to crewing and customer relationships, even though recent travel-market disruption may have left results somewhat below aspiration.

We would be more likely to drop this portal because a stand-alone digital information product is easier to redeploy resources away from if adoption appears to fall short of aspirations relative to core services and peers.
We would keep this app for now because vessel-performance tools are strategically close to the core business and a large firm can afford another period of learning before reallocating the resources.
